cd_package.description: The signature-cd.zip built by both CD flows: 'signature-cd.wav' (all tracks at 44.1 kHz / 16-bit stereo), 'disc.cue' (cue sheet marking each track start), 'BURNING-GUIDE.txt'. Browsers cannot drive a CD burner directly — the package is for the user's own burner software.

cue_sheet.description: Cue-sheet format: FILE "signature-cd.wav" WAVE, then per track TRACK NN AUDIO / TITLE / INDEX 01 MM:SS:FF (frames at 75 fps). Track numbers zero-padded to 2 digits.

cd_session_state.description: The persisted CD state inside a Studio Session project (project.schema.json studio_session.cd): the ordered track IDs plus the album/artist tagging used by the tagged CD build in assets/app6b.js.

tracks.description: Ordered JAH-SONG-###### IDs. Stage 7 lets the user reorder (up/down) and remove.

cd_track.description: One rendered track in a CD build. RUNTIME OBJECT: built in memory during the render; 'buf' is a Web Audio AudioBuffer and is never persisted or serialized. In the album-maker flow (assets/app3.js) the track carries id+title+buf+start; in the Studio Session tagged build (assets/app6b.js) it carries title+buf+start. Tracks are laid end to end with a 2-second gap (start += buf.duration + 2).

buf.description: Runtime-only: the rendered Web Audio AudioBuffer. Never persisted, never serialized; absent from any JSON form of the track.

id.description: Present in the album-maker flow; absent in the stage-7 tagged build. JAH-SONG-######.

start.description: Track start time in seconds within the CD-length render.

description: CD records. Reserved ID scheme JAH-CD-%07d — no CD IDs have been issued as of 2026-10-03; the two CD builders (album maker in assets/app3.js, tagged build in assets/app6b.js) work with in-memory track objects and the session CD state.
title: Signature Music Studio — CD record
